after.zh: 两次叉积就找到了交点，不用解方程。三个数 (X, Y, W) 表示点 (X/W, Y/W)；两条线平行时 W = 0，交点在无穷远处，齐次坐标照样写得出来。
after.en: Two cross products find the meeting point with no equations to solve. Three numbers (X, Y, W) stand for the point (X/W, Y/W); when the lines are parallel W = 0 and they meet at infinity, which homogeneous coordinates can still write down.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-7-5"></part-ref>输出两个三维向量的叉积 a × b。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-7-5"></part-ref> in the tray outputs the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每条线给出它上面的两个点，输出两条线的交点。
t.en: Your task in this level: each line is given by two points on it; output where the two lines meet.

brief.zh: 每个点写成 (x, y, 1)。线一过 p、q，线二过 r、s。输出两条线的交点，也写成三个数（不必把第三个数化成 1）。
brief.en: Each point is written (x, y, 1). Line 1 passes through p and q, line 2 through r and s. Output where the two lines meet, also as three numbers (no need to make the third one 1).

hint.zh: 叉积能从两个点得到一条线。
hint.en: The cross product turns two points into a line.
